root_cause_criterion.criterion: After `zend_add_attribute()` allocates a two-argument `zend_attribute`, it must initialize the second `argv[]` slot to `IS_UNDEF` before the partially built attribute can be inserted and later destroyed. The vulnerable original returns from this root site with raw allocator bytes still in `attr->argv[1]`, while the fixed original writes the required `ZVAL_UNDEF` sentinel before the same cleanup path executes.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing second-slot initialization in `zend_add_attribute()`. On the crashing execution the tracked `attr->argv[1]` leaves the root site with non-`IS_UNDEF` type info (`3200171710`), whereas the fixed original reaches the same protected cleanup with `argv1_type_info=0`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The fixed original genuinely exercises the protected `slot_cleanup` event with `argv1_type_info == IS_UNDEF`, so no perturbation was required.

nodes.description: At the selected `i == 1` cleanup iteration, `free_attribute()` reaches `zval_ptr_dtor(&attr->argv[i])` while the second slot still has non-`IS_UNDEF` type info.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `slot_type_info=3200171710` and `undef_type_literal=0` at `slot_cleanup`.

nodes.description: `zend_gc_delref()` receives the bogus refcounted-header pointer extracted from the stale second `argv[]` slot and immediately dereferences `p->refcount`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `gc_argument=0xbebebebebebebebe`, the same bogus pointer carried from `slot_cleanup.ref_argument` into the sink.

edges.relation: The exact second-slot address created at `zend_add_attribute()` is the same `zval_ptr_dtor()` target later visited by `free_attribute()` during request shutdown.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `attr_alloc.argv1_addr == slot_cleanup.slot_addr == 0x606000013248`; the fixed original preserves the same address equality for the clean second-slot cleanup.

edges.relation: The same bogus `zend_refcounted_h *` decoded from the second slot at cleanup is passed unchanged into `zend_gc_delref()` as its `p` argument.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `slot_cleanup.ref_argument == gc_delref_sink.gc_argument == 0xbebebebebebebebe`.
